requirements.REL01: Every analog contact is zero at its own first point; replacement fingers get fresh origins.
requirements.REL02: Small symmetric neutral interval, followed by a short continuous linear ramp to saturation.
requirements.REL03: Steering samples horizontal displacement only; vertical gas/brake samples vertical displacement only, up for gas and down for brake.
requirements.REL04: Handbrake remains a separate full-strength held button; each axis has independent finger ownership and lifecycle cleanup.
requirements.REL05: Retain buttons, keyboard/gamepad, saved layouts and canonical input/physics; native markers move without rebuilding control draw commands.

implementation.pedal_layout: One vertical axis in both analog modes, using the saved accelerator position/scale/opacity; separate brake settings remain intact for buttons mode.
implementation.manual_choice: No reply to the optional combined-versus-separate-pedal clarification arrived during implementation; used one vertical gas/brake axis as described in commentary.
